references.text: Pagiel, son of Ocran, is first mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Asher at the census.
Pagiel, son of Ocran, brought his offering as the leader of the tribe of Asher at the dedication of the tabernacle.
Pagiel, son of Ocran, led the army of the tribe of Asher when the Israelites broke camp from Sinai.
The tribe of Asher descends from Asher, Jacob's son with Zilpah, Leah's maidservant.
Jacob's blessing over Asher, the patriarch of the tribe.
Moses' blessing over the tribe of Asher.
